description: This Java source file defines a final class DittoPublicKeyProvider that implements the PublicKeyProvider interface. The class manages fetching, caching, and providing public keys based on issuer and key ID, primarily for JWT validation. It utilizes HTTP calls to openID discovery endpoints, parses JSON Web Keys, and caches responses to improve performance and reduce network load.

classes.name: DittoPublicKeyProvider
classes.description: Implements PublicKeyProvider, manages fetching and caching of public keys from issuer discovery endpoints, primarily used for JWT validation.

methods.name: of
methods.description: Creates a new instance of DittoPublicKeyProvider with given configuration, HTTP client, and cache settings.

methods.name: getPublicKey
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves a public key based on issuer and key ID, utilizing cache.

methods.name: loadPublicKey
methods.description: Loads a public key asynchronously from the issuer’s discovery endpoint, used internally by cache.

methods.name: getDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Constructs the URL for OpenID discovery based on the issuer string.

methods.name: mapResponseToJsonArray
methods.description: Parses HttpResponse to extract JSON array of keys.

methods.name: getPublicKeysFromDiscoveryEndpoint
methods.description: Fetches the discovery document and JWKs from the issuer’s endpoint.

methods.name: mapResponseToJsonObject
methods.description: Converts HttpResponse entity to a JSON object.

methods.name: handleNonSuccessResponse
methods.description: Handles HTTP responses with non-success status codes, logging and throwing exceptions.

methods.name: getBodyAsString
methods.description: Converts HttpResponse entity data bytes into a String.

methods.name: mapToPublicKey
methods.description: Finds a matching public key from JSON Web Keys, constructs a PublicKey instance.
